text:
lara_marketing: quick sync 
- goal: get SEO bundle ready for next week's webinar push (landing, hero post, 3 pillars, thanks page)
- deliverables: redirect CSV, keyword clusters, JSON-LD snippets, internal anchor map, UTM templates

dexter_seo: i'll own keyword clusters + redirect CSV. will keep 3 priority longtails per page and a canonical plan. 

nina_prod: messaging variant check: use the product benefits version in meta descriptions or the cost-savings copy? which performed better in trials?

paul_growth: cost-savings copy drove higher signups in trial cohort. recommend cost-savings in meta descriptions and hero H1; keep value prop brief.

dexter_seo: noted. draft redirect examples for the CSV:
```
old_path,new_path,type,reason
/blog/draft-launch,/blog/launch-hero,301,merge duplicates
/webinar-v1,/webinar,302,temp validate tracking
/offer/old-thanks,/thanks,301,consolidate
```
will flip 302 -> 301 after analytics validation.

eli_eng: redirect window scheduled Thu 05:00-06:00 UTC. process: apply 302s, smoke test, then convert to 301. SRE will monitor.

dexter_seo: schema plan: webinar landing -> Event/Webinar JSON-LD (name,startDate,url,organizer). blog posts -> BlogPosting + image + author. i'll paste snippets to the ticket.

nina_prod: anchor plan: hero post link to pillar A and B in intro; webinar landing links to pillar C and thank-you in CTA module. keep anchor text natural.

paul_growth: UTMs: utm_source=webinar_launch, utm_medium=cta, utm_campaign=may_launch; add utm_content variants hero/email/social. maps to HubSpot routing.

ops-bot: Ticket created: #MK-4992 "Webinar SEO bundle: redirects, schema, anchors, UTMs" 
Assignees: dexter_seo, nina_prod, paul_growth, eli_eng. Reminder set for 2024-05-06T09:00:00Z.

lara_marketing: action items: dexter -> keywords, redirect CSV, JSON-LD by Tue 11:00. nina -> anchor placements + CTA copy by Tue 14:00. paul -> finalize UTMs + heatmap summary by Tue 15:00. eli -> confirm redirect job + SRE handoff. i'll run preflight Tue evening. :rocket:
